text_block_list.text:
I spotted Mr. C.B. and Gold City having a 
casual chat.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—So if you leave that alone, I'm sure 
people will misunderstand CB-senpai as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

Looking at where Gold City was staring— a 
group of a dozen or so students were 
hanging out for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Free-spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Today I ate my bento before class 
even startedâ that's freedom for ya.

text_block_list.name: Carefree Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. As for me, I ended up doing my 
morning run in sandals—I'm free like that, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Untamed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Weak. I got so caught up in the momentum 
that I ran all the way to the next town 
and ended up late. Talk about the 
ultimate... freedom.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Kids who look up to CB-senpai and try to 
copy her... or think they are, at least. 
Seems like there are quite a few, mostly 
underclassmen."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Your hairstyle and earrings kinda look 
like mine, too. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Free-spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Ah!? It's C.B.-senpai!? Good mor――

text_block_list.name: Carefree Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...No, not like that! If you're a senpai, 
you should be more refreshing, with a 
lighter vibe—

text_block_list.name: C.B. Alliance
text_block_list.text: ――Hey there, CB!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't her attitude a bit much?

More than looking up to someone... isn't 
this just being an impressionist comedian? 
Just as I thought that—

text_block_list.name: Carefree Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's raining! Speaking of C.B.-senpai, 
she's famous for freely enjoying walks 
without minding the rain at all!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Alliance
text_block_list.text:
This is worth a ton of Freedom Points! 
Hurry~!

“—All of them dashed out onto the 
rain-soaked field at once.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Everyone looks like they're having 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Senpai, I really think you should give 
them a firm warning at least once.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right now, people just see them as an odd 
group, but if we leave them alone, strange 
rumors might start spreading about 
CB-senpai too.
choice_data_list: So what do you think about it yourself?
How do you feel about it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sounds totally fine to me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't you being a bit too optimistic?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Still, those kids are free 
to imitate me if they want.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm free to act however I want too. Isn't 
it as simple as that?
choice_data_list: I wonder... if that's really true?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's totally fine. Unless it ends 
up causing trouble for someone else, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Welp, alright then. Guess I'll head on 
over for a bit too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: The track! Now I wanna run too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...She never wavers. That's precisely why 
there are girls who look up to her and 
want to copy her, though."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even so, those girls... Just how much 
further are they planning to copy their 
senior?
choice_data_list:
Are you planning to copy my training 
too...?

Wouldn't that running technique be 
impossible to copy?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute. Could it be... If 
CB-senpai hits the gym right now, those 
kids will copy her and follow along—

—A few days later. Those concerns became 
reality... and the gym ended up completely 
overrun with Mr. C.B.s.

text_block_list.name: Free-spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... In this case, what would give me 
the highest freedom points? Leg dumbbell 
curls, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, watch out! If you don't use the 
equipment properly, you'll get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Free-spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, yes! Thank y—no, I mean, I'm so 
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "—Phew! That was a good workout!"

text_block_list.name: C.B. Alliance
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...! That was brutal...! 
I... I sweated so much...!

"...They're free to imitate her. That 
said, the day these kids truly close the 
gap with their idol still seemed far, far 
away."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I guess so, but... Shouldn't that 
be the very first thing you try to copy in 
the first place?"
And then—during training a few days later.

text_block_list.name: C.B. Alliance
text_block_list.text: *gasp*, *wheeze*... *pant*...!

Although several students tried to emulate 
Mr. C.B. and run after her... one by one, 
they dropped out.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
――Alright, time to start picking up the 
pace!

text_block_list.name: Free-spirited Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
T-They really are amazing... I guess just 
copying the surface is totally 
pointless...!

text_block_list.name: Carefree Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still... CB-senpai really is so cool, 
after all...!

From that day on, although the copycat 
antics died down, Mr. C.B.'s fanbase only 
seemed to grow larger and larger.
